ablation: precision head: estimated (default PrecisionEstimator) vs uniform (uniform_precision=True, pi=1). Both arms intact (lesion_l1=False), identical init seeds, identical transition streams.

background.evidence: Throwaway-seed probe (99901, delayed_multistep): lesioned-estimated held-out mean|rerr|=0.8256 vs intact 0.2809 (D_rerr=+0.54) on held-out rewards in {0.0, 0.02}. Lesioned reward head exploded (b_r=0.31, max|w_r|=0.73, predicting rhat=1.27 on a 0.02 tick). Control: lesioned with uniform_precision=True stays sane (b_r=0.018, mean|rerr|=0.10).
background.mechanism_hypothesis: Rare terminal +1.0 spikes (5/600 train transitions) lower rerr variance -> estimated piR stays high -> massive per-spike w_r updates (d = eta_r * piR * rerr * f) with no R_ctx absorber under lesion. Same precision pathology family as the C2 kill (C2 kill FRAGILE 3/5).
background.pilot: EXP-AB-K3C task-1 pilot (throwaway seeds 99901/99902, pre-preregistration, methods validation only).

baseline: arch_b uniform_precision=True (pi=1 everywhere), identical transitions and init seeds.

conditions.references: symbolic baseline (deterministic): pomaze frontier exploration (10/10 solves, ~43 steps); delayed_reward branch_a + forward; changing_rule WSLS. Train episodes then held-out episodes with disjoint episode seeds.

decision_rule: Per task per seed: explosion signature iff mean|rerr|_estimated_terminal >= 3 * mean|rerr|_uniform_terminal AND mean|rerr|_estimated_terminal > 0.3. Task signature iff >= 3/4 seeds show it. SYSTEMATIC iff >= 2 of 3 tasks show the task signature; TASK-LOCAL iff exactly 1; ABSENT iff 0. CHARACTERIZATION verdict, not a kill.

gates_void.G0a: held-out terminal trials == 0 for a task -> VOID that task (fail-closed).
gates_void.G0b: fabrication-tripwire CLEAN on new/modified code, pre-run.
gates_void.G0c: determinism spot-check: seed 74301 arm E recomputed -> b_r identical to 1e-12, else VOID.

hypothesis: The estimated-precision reward head systematically misbehaves on rare high-reward events: across tasks with rare terminal spikes, intact ArchB with estimated precision shows the explosion signature on terminal-spike trials while the uniform-precision control stays sane; on a dense-reward task the signature is absent.
limitations_preregistered: Open-loop training isolates the weight/precision machinery (K3/K3B/K3C precedent); closed-loop control effects factored out by design. Intact models only - the pilot sighting was lesioned; if the signature needs the lesion's missing R_ctx absorber this design will show TASK-LOCAL/ABSENT and that boundary is itself the finding.
metric: Per task per seed, on held-out terminal-spike trials (reward >= 0.5): explosion signature iff mean|rerr|_estimated_terminal >= 3x mean|rerr|_uniform_terminal AND mean|rerr|_estimated_terminal > 0.3. Task signature iff >= 3/4 seeds show it.
null: No systematic estimated-vs-uniform difference on terminal-spike trials across tasks.
procedure: Per task per seed: (1) collect transition stream with the symbolic reference baseline - train episodes then held-out episodes with disjoint episode seeds; (2) two INTACT ArchB (lesion_l1=False) with IDENTICAL init seeds train open-loop via learn_transition on the identical train stream - arm E estimated precision (default), arm F uniform_precision=True; (3) held-out eval via predict_reward -> |rhat-r|; terminal-spike trials flagged reward >= 0.5 (same flag as K3B/K3C).
secondaries: post-training b_r and max|w_r| per arm (L0 reward head weight stats)
mean piR on terminal training trials (arm E) - does estimated piR sit near pi_max on spikes?
training-stream rerr variance (arm E) - the low-variance -> high-piR mechanism link
